proposals.before: He was again given Qin acting credentials and made Commander of the three commandery armies of Heng province to subdue the rebellious Man of Guiyang, Yangshan, and Shixing; on arrival he at once pacified and broke them.
proposals.after: He was again given acting credentials and made Commander of the three commandery armies of Heng province to subdue the rebellious Man of Guiyang, Yangshan, and Shixing; on arrival he at once pacified and broke them.
proposals.reason: In 又假欽節, 欽 is Lan Qin, the recipient of the acting credentials; inserting 'Qin' between 'given' and 'acting credentials' makes the English ungrammatical and misparses the construction.

decisions.reason: s0153 又假欽節 grants Lan Qin (欽) acting credentials (假節); the before text misparses 欽 as modifying the credentials, and removing it yields accurate English.
